text: Working with APIs is an essential skill for modern developers. Most APIs communicate through HTTP requests, where your application sends a request to a server and receives a response. The data usually comes back in JSON format, which is easy to read and parse. Before you can access an API, you often need authentication, such as an API key or token, to prove your identity. It is also important to respect rate limits, which restrict how many requests you can make within a certain time. Finally, always include error handling in your code to manage failed requests or unexpected responses gracefully.
